summary: Verified the Sep 13 2026 'skip only the bad line/PO, keep the good ones going' fix + upfront Supplier-Portal product_id guard. Wrote 10 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_missing_product_id_skip_iter164.py: 9 PASSED, 1 SKIPPED (unrelated `open-pos` endpoint name mismatch - not part of this fix). (A) _post_one_po unit tests, no live SAP: all-lines-missing_product_id -> whole PO returns status='skipped' with `skipped_items` listing every item + Product-ID-missing reason; partial-missing -> soap_items sent to notification_client.maintain_bundle contains ONLY the valid lines (10 & 30, no None product_id), skipped_items in the final result contains just the bad line (20), status='posted', downstream Playwright helpers monkey-patched so no real browser/SAP call happens. (B) _skipped_line_items_from_gr_results correctly pulls {(po_number, item_number)} tuples out of a per_po list where some POs are 'posted' with skipped_items. _post_goods_movement_for_items with a skipped_line_items set of {('PO1','20')} across 3 shipment lines calls goods_movement_client.goods_movement EXACTLY twice (PO1/10 and PO2/10), never for PO1/20, and adds a per_item entry for PO1/20 with ok=True/skipped=True/note='Goods Receipt for this line was skipped in SAP (missing Product ID) - no stock to move'. When ALL lines are flagged, goods_movement is not called at all. (C) Live REAL API test against `POST /api/supplier-portal/shipments` on the preview URL using vendor1@testco.com / DummyTest123 (S9999 dummy vendor). Seeded 2 po_cache docs for a synthetic TESTITER164_* PO: item 1 with a real product_id, item 2 with product_id=None. Result: (i) POST with item 2 alone -> HTTP 400, detail contains 'Product ID is missing' + item number 2 + the PO number - exactly the expected message. (ii) POST with item 1 alone -> HTTP 200, shipment doc returned with product_id='TESTPROD_ITER164'. (iii) POST with BOTH items -> HTTP 400 (whole request rejected on the bad line) - proves the guard runs before any persistence. (D) Regression: GET /api/supplier-portal/shipments still returns 200 for the vendor session. Frontend GrnApprovalPage.jsx code-reviewed: 'View Diagnostics' trigger conditions at lines 816 and 1105 now use `(p.status !== 'posted' && p.events?.length) || p.skipped_items?.length`, so a posted PO with skipped_items DOES show the button (matches spec). The Diagnostics Dialog (lines 1180-1225) has data-testid='grn-diagnostics-skipped-items' amber box with data-testid=`grn-diagnostics-skipped-item-{i}` per row and shows the 'Posted to SAP - but item(s) below were dropped from this PO' header on posted+skipped POs (line 1189). Cleanup: test-created po_cache and shipment docs removed at fixture teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: sap_playwright_supplier_pgr_service._post_one_po - `skipped_items` accumulates once at line 385 from the pre-existing missing_products; if a later step ALSO reports a failed line (e.g. _fill_line_actual_quantities returns unfilled item numbers), those unfilled lines take the whole-PO _capture_failure path with an aggregated error but don't get added to skipped_items - acceptable because that path returns status='failed' (not 'posted'), so downstream Goods Movement is skipped for the whole PO anyway.

supplier_shipment_service._resolve_items - the missing product_id check is fine, but note the error message concatenates unsanitized item_number/po_number into user-facing text. Both come from user input in ShipmentCreateRequest - not a security concern (no HTML rendering server-side) but flagging that if any future channel echoes the raw error into HTML it must escape.

GrnApprovalPage.jsx trigger condition duplicated verbatim in two places (lines 816 and 1105) - would be safer to extract into a helper like `hasDiagnostics(shipment)` to avoid future drift between the Pending list view and the Confirmed detail view.
GrnApprovalPage.jsx now 1234 lines - past the 700-line guideline, previously called out.

rca of the issue: Before this session's changes, a single PO line whose cached product_id was None caused the whole PO to be aborted at the SOAP-create step of _post_one_po, even when the PO's other lines were perfectly fine - user's complaint: 'if 1 PO or 1 line is skipped, other POs should get written with GRN completed'. Fix: (1) _post_one_po now separates missing_products, drops just those keys from item_qtys/item_products/soap_items, continues through the SOAP + UI fill steps for the remaining valid lines, and returns status='posted' with a `skipped_items` list carrying only the bad line(s) - falls back to status='skipped' (unchanged legacy behavior) only when every line is bad. (2) _post_goods_movement_for_items now takes an explicit skipped_line_items set (built by _skipped_line_items_from_gr_results from the sap_gr_result.per_po) and marks matching (po_number,item_number) pairs as ok/skipped without calling goods_movement - since those lines never actually posted a GR in SAP, there's no stock at source to move. (3) Root cause of the bad lines reaching GRN in the first place was that the Supplier Portal accepted shipments against PO lines whose SAP product master link was missing - fixed upfront by _resolve_items raising ShipmentValidationError (-> HTTP 400) when cached.product_id is falsy, with a message pointing back to SAP Admin. Frontend now shows the amber 'Dropped item(s)' box + 'Posted to SAP - but item(s) below were dropped' banner in the GRN Diagnostics modal for the mixed-outcome case.
